evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence

observations.why: Opposed terms (owned vs. rented) set in a single contrastive frame, with 'not the same as' negating one side.

evidence.quote: The substrate is a commodity; the perspective is the asset you keep

observations.why: Two matched 'the X is the Y' clauses joined by a semicolon, with commodity opposed to asset.
